snippet.title: Armored Aces Official 2017 trailer
snippet.description:
A free team-based multiplayer 3D online tank battle game for android and iOS phones and tablets.
Get it on android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.blitzkriegmmo.game
Download for iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/en/app/armored-aces/id877529227?mt=8

Select your tank from many World War II and Modern Era armored monsters and battle thousands of real people worldwide!

facebook: https://www.facebook.com/armoredacesmmo/
webpage: http://armoredaces.com/
